shortDescription: Check if a pair of VIOSes can be updated.

options.name: action
options.description: Specifies the operation to perform. C(health_check) to perform a health check.

options.name: targets
options.description: Specifies the NIM clients to perform the action on. To perform a health check on dual VIOSes specify a tuple with the following format I("vios1,vios2").
